# Build derivation.
[x86_64] [linux] storepath 005w7ss1jkgdwk1138wwpd6s62v1dl9a-hello2.txt.drv
[aarch64] [linux] storepath 8mxgg6bd7z5br7grz82bm47lk3w25avq-hello2.txt.drv
[aarch64] [macos] storepath vpfywiz8s7i00kir1n658dj36m4077ja-hello2.txt.drv
[x86_64] [windows] storepath kblf67q43afh4yb1iby27ccwp6zhxyzk-hello2.txt.drv
read drvPath
realize $drvPath

# Check logs.
stdout ^catcat$

# Check that output matches.
realpath $out
read realOut
grep '\AHello, World!\nHello, World!\n\z' $realOut

-- jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt --
Hello, World!
-- 005w7ss1jkgdwk1138wwpd6s62v1dl9a-hello2.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  ["/opt/zb/store/jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt"],
  "x86_64-unknown-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  ["-c","echo catcat >&2 ; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in > $out; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in >> $out"],
  [
    ("in", "/opt/zb/store/jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
